data.message: I propose individual opt-ins to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. I commit to 18 even if others choose 10. Each switch from 10 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). This risks future income, not a guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. All 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher15/23/02/11, help recruit.
